description: This file defines two custom exception classes, RandomlyInjectedStorageException and RandomlyInjectedInconsistentStateException, within the Orleans.TestingHost namespace. These exceptions are serializable and are used to represent fault injection scenarios in testing storage components.

classes.name: RandomlyInjectedStorageException
classes.description: A serializable exception class representing a randomly injected storage fault used in testing scenarios.

classes.name: RandomlyInjectedInconsistentStateException
classes.description: A serializable exception class representing a randomly injected inconsistent state fault, deriving from InconsistentStateException.

methods.name: RandomlyInjectedStorageException
methods.description: Default constructor setting a default message 'injected fault'.

methods.name: RandomlyInjectedInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Default constructor setting a default message 'injected fault'.
